newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shares of Orix Corp hit record high.
newsitem.headline: Shares of Orix Corp hit record high.

text.p: Shares of Orix Corp hit a record high on Tuesday morning, rising on the Tokyo Stock Exchange for the fourth consecutive day, traders said.
By 0028 GMT, Orix's shares were up 90 yen at 9,900 yen.
The previous high was 9,850 yen marked on Monday.

"There are many investors who are trying to include Orix in their portfolio as they think the company will benefit from Japan's 'Big Bang' financial deregulation and will be able to expand its business," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said.
"Orix shares are attracting investors also because their volatility is high and price movements are active," he said.
